description: 3D Street is a software platform listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Platforms and Software Resources > Transportation Planning Tools and Platforms", published or maintained by as named on 3dstreet.org. An open-source 3D street design and virtual reality application that allows users to directly import their street designs from Streetmix into an interactive 3D web scene. Apart from the community version, it also provides a Pro version with integration with Google Earth and further customization. Coverage: as described in the entry; the linked page was not read. The list files it under "Platforms and Software Resources > Transportation Planning Tools and Platforms". The entry links to 3dstreet.org. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. The entry links to a product or project page, not a repository, so open-source status was not confirmed and is recorded as false. It can support transport and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-apa-urban-regional-planning-resources-list.
